q: The Julia set J(f) and Fatou set F(f) of a rational map f are related by:
opts: J(f) = ℂ \ F(f) (they partition the Riemann sphere)
J(f) is always a Cantor set
exp: J(f) and F(f) form a partition of the Riemann sphere Ĉ: J is where the family {fⁿ} is NOT normal (equicontinuous), F is where it IS normal. J is closed and completely invariant; F is open and completely invariant.
